coordinateSystem: Pixels in the final alpha WebP; hand-measured text safe regions

corner-b-header.notes: Native image contains no text or button glyphs. Keep the whole header proportional so its circular rivets remain round. Positions and control size scale together.

corner-b-journal.notes: Prefer equal-axis scaling of the whole journal. Rivets occur along the spine, including near y=495, so vertically stretching the image or middle border slice would distort circles. Content can scroll independently inside the page. Existing scene tentacles should cover the lower-right page.

corner-b-control.notes: The same square base is used by both controls. Add a separate dedicated icon; use equal width/height and contain.
